## Contribution rules for radius-project/radius

- AI/automated contributions are restricted; follow the conditions below exactly. (https://github.com/radius-project/radius/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L30)
- Only work on open issues labelled `triaged` AND (`help wanted` OR `good first issue`), that are not assigned to someone else and have no open PR; re-check right before opening the PR. (https://github.com/radius-project/radius/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L30)
- For non-trivial changes, open or find an issue and agree on the approach first. (https://github.com/radius-project/radius/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L29)
- Sign off every commit (`git commit -s`) with the human's name and email, never the agent's. (https://github.com/radius-project/radius/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L36)
- Commits must be cryptographically signed (GPG/SSH) and show as Verified. (https://github.com/radius-project/radius/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L54)
